notes.title: Calling Home Development goes on hiatus
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

we wanted to take a moment to update you on the future of Calling Home. First off, we want to thank you all for your support & feedback during this journey. Watching you play & hearing your thoughts meant a lot to us.

Unfortunately, we have to share some difficult news. 
Through internal complications and changes in the core team we need to take a break from Calling Home.

This was not an easy decision, and we truly wish to continue our work on the project in the future.

We know it’s been a while since our last update and we regret not being able to communicate sooner. We appreciate your patience and understanding. Even though we have to pause the work on Calling Home currently, we want to emphasize how much we appreciate you all, the community that built around Calling Home. 

Thank you all for being with us so far.

Your Calling Home Team

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Good day, Community!

The summer sun is shining and we used the energy to improve many features of the game. The game is much more stable now and we managed to clean up our codebase to further enable a smooth development. Moreover, the Gamescom is taking place this week! If you are in the Cologne area feel free to swing by and say hello!
As always a big thank you for your continued support and feel free to leave any feedback or report any bugs you might have. We will do our best to bring Calling Home to the next level!

Have a look at the Patch Notes:

[h1]What's new?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Refactored many UI Systems for a significant boost in performance overall
[*] Added new sound effects for many interactions in the game
[*] Added more feedback to the research table
[*] Added more settings options for graphics
[*] Added input remapping support for keyboard controls
[*] Added mouse inversion settings
[*] Added a confirmation window to research nodes
[/list]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the settings safe structure to be more reliable
[*] Changed our highlights to not linger anymore and support inner mesh edges
[*] Changed the facility and miner output slots to the same drag structure of other inventories

[*] improved loading times overall
[*] improved building loading sequence
[*] improved chunk mesh generation
[*] improved chunk object / point of interest handling
[*] improved item icons to better visualize their function
[*] improved the build mode for a smoother experience
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Balanced the scan distance for interactables (miners or PoIs) to 128 (prev. 64)
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where many menus did not function correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where inventory slots did not function correctly
[*] Fixed a bug where settings were not saved between game reloads
[*] Fixed a bug where chunk loading took much longer than expected
[*] Fixed a bug where objects could spawn under the planets surface
[*] Fixed a bug where items would not drop if an inventory was full
[*] Fixed a bug where miners did not find their resources after a reload
[*] Fixed a bug where droneHUBs did not find their miners or bases after a reload
[*] Fixed a bug where the players inventory did not save correctly
[*] And many more minor bugs as well!
[/list]

notes.title: Spring Update 2024
notes.content:
Good Evening, Community!

The Calling Home Spring Update is here and we're proud to announce a lot of new features & visual updates. In addition to completely new features, we have improved existing performance and look.


Have a look at the Patch Notes:

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
[b]Added new Biomes[/b] - some new environments for you to explore!
[b]Added new Points of Interest [/b]- Discover mysterious constructions and solve their puzzles!
[b]New & improved UI [/b]- E.g. the Compass now displays the distance for all scanned objects
[b]New Upgrade & Equipment System[/b] - Add different buffs to your character!
[b]New Ingame Wiki [/b]- Forgetting crafting receipts won't be a problem for you anymore!
[b]Respawn System[/b] - Dying isn't problematic, as you're spawing back in your base!
[b]Hazards (Radiation, Temperature)[/b] - Watch out for dangerous environments, manage your oxygen and prepare yourself with newly added equipment!
[b]New flora graphics[/b] - You can't hug any trees yet, but at least they're prettier now!
[b]Improved facility models[/b]- Inserter, Smelter, Drone Hubs and other objetcs got new models and textures

[h2]General[/h2]

[b]Performance improvements[/b] - several improvements so you won't feel dizzy while playing!
[b]New Versioning System[/b] - Old save states can still be used via Steam if game updates require you to start a new game

[h2]Language[/h2]

[b]French and Russian Localization partially implemented[/b] - Quests might have some issues with displaying correctly

[h2]Known issues[/h2]

[b]Some points of Interests are a little floaty [/b]- Who needs gravity anyway?
[b]Task text is sometimes misplaced
Resources spawn scarcely in the swamp biome[/b]
[b]Some icons might not show in the new POI's[/b]



As already announced you will have to make a new game in order to fully experience the new update. You can still access your old save states via Steam.
We hope you have fun trying it out for yourself! Please don't hesitate to contact us if you encounter any problems or bugs.

The Crystal Fox Team

notes.title: Announcing Spring Update 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to announce the Calling Homes Spring Update coming on May 17th!
This update brings some of our biggest feature updates to make your explorations even more exciting.

Included are numerous visual updates, as well as new biomes and hazards. To keep your survival rates high, players can now equip multiple upgrades to their characters to provide some cool buffs and other benefits - also keep an eye out for new points of interests discover!

[i]To experience the new content you'll need to start a new game. Accessing your old saves can be done by right clicking on Calling Home in Steam, select Properties - Betas - Beta Participation and select the matching version for your old save state.[/i]

notes.title: We need your opinion!
notes.content:
Hey guys, we always say we want to develop Calling Home with our community. So here is your first chance to actively influence the game. We are currently discussing how to approach our player upgrade system and want your opinion on the matter. So far, we narrowed it down to 2 options and we want to know which of these options sound more fun to you. 

[b]Microchips and Slots[/b]
The player gets a fixed number of microchip-slots in their suit. Microchips will be researched and once unlocked, can be equipped at your base. Because there are more microchips than slots you would have to decide which chips make the most sense for your current planets’ environment, or task you want to do.
This system could also lead to more interesting points of interest, but on the other hand it could also have some tedious side effects e.g. if you are out exploring and notice that you need to change your microchips to solve a puzzle at a point of interest.


[b]Permanent Upgrades[/b]
The player can research upgrades at their research table which will permanently unlock them. The upgrades can be toggled on and off, but if you desire, you could always enable all of them. This would be more set and forget and give you more time to automate or adventure, but also limit your decision making regarding your adventures.

In our opinion both Ideas have positive and negative aspects and could impact how Calling Home feels greatly. Also keep in mind that none of the decisions are final. We might change the feature in the future if it turns out to be boring or just not fun. 

If you want to help us develop Calling Home click [url=https://forms.gle/FyVuCZes2UhekTbV7]here [/url]and give us your opinion!

[*] Added stone and removed biomatter from the possible resources the miner can mine

[*] Performance improvements
[/list]

[h2]Design[/h2]

[list]
[*] Temporarily set aspect ratio to 16x9 only, until other resolutions are more stable
[*] Limit save file name length to 20 symbols
[*] Display collected research points as a popup
[*] M.A.R.S. now gives feedback after repairing the communicator
[*] Added popup in the settings menu that resets graphics settings after some time if not accepted
[*] Added tool tip for research points to clarify where to get them
[/list]


[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the environment could not be generated correctly crashing the planet
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could fall through the planet
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could place multiple facilities ontop another
[*] Fixed an issue where the miner wasn´t informed when a resource node ran dry
[*] Fixed an issue where item slots stayed on the screen if a menu was closed mid-drag
[*] Fixed an issue where points of interest did not respawn at the same location
[*] Fixed a bug where research points weren't saved correctly when leaving the game
[*] Fixed a bug that caused medium workshops to change into small workshop after reloading
[*] M.A.R.S. no longer pops up multiple times when a smelter or a small workshop is placed

notes.title: Early Access just launched!
notes.content:
[h1]Calling all space explorers![/h1]

We're thrilled to announce that [b]Calling Home just launched into Early Access[/b]! You can finally explore our universe by yourself!

During Early Access, we'll be actively updating and fine-tuning the game based on player feedback, so you can expect to see new features, improvements, and fixes added frequently. We're grateful for everyone's support and patience so far, and can't wait to work together with the community to make Calling Home a truly incredible experience!

If you wanna join our community, [url=https://linktr.ee/crystalfoxmedia]click here[/url] to check out our socials!


Have fun!
[i]- Your Crystal Fox Team[/i]
